title: Walk Ceremony — rich
forward_vector: I am the manifest of Walk Ceremony's rich face: what was made for each section, and the fingerprint of the words each piece was made against, so the page can say when a piece may lag the text. I grow when the entry is enriched again; I never hold the entry's words.
note: A light face, from the second light round (2026-11-17): one small thing beside one sentence. Made as if it were the only page: one maker who read the page whole, one challenger who was given nothing of the maker's reasoning, one remake, and a second verdict by the same challenger. Made in Enrichment/light-round-2026-11-2/pieces/Walk Ceremony/, where the script, the job and its provenance stay; placed here by the Concierge, with what made it copied from that provenance and not guessed. Loudon approved the line it was made from ("Yes, make them", 2026-11-17, relayed by the working session) and has not seen or heard the finished piece. The section is a proposal until he approves it.

verdicts.file: Walk Ceremony — rich — one step of a walk.png
verdicts.why: Of the first version, "Every door in the palace", which stays in the workshop: every number checked out and the words did not. On this page a door is the entry a walk starts from, so the title misled; "a walker meets it with no instruction" is false of the palace, since SCHEMA's table and the Jewel give the attention; the 2,497 line gave the wrong reason; it was tall, about seventy words, and mostly a chart.

remade.file: Walk Ceremony — rich — one step of a walk.png
remade.what: A new piece in its place, "One step of a walk": the one typed link out of this page, to The Cooperation Path, and the seven that lead on from there, each group with the attention its type asks for.
remade.by: the walk-ceremony maker, the same maker
remade.second_verdict: keep: Judged as a new piece; every link, count and quoted phrase recomputed and matching. The step shows none of the three types the page gives a question for, a cost that is real, owned, and not enough to send it back, since the page's only link was not cherry-picked. SCHEMA's "traceable lineage" for `spawned` is a stretch as an attention: SCHEMA gives it as a reason for writing the link. Offered and not required: The Cooperation Path has its own question at each of these five stops, which would give the reader a question per step.

pieces.title: One step of a walk
pieces.caption: A walk from this page has one link to follow, and it leads to The Cooperation Path. There, seven typed links lead on. Their types say what attention to bring: five are `connects-to`, which this page says to follow with curiosity rather than expectation; one `deepens` and one `spawned` link get no question from this page, and SCHEMA's link table gives their meaning instead. Across the palace, about half of all typed links are `connects-to` (1,202 of 2,496).
